summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for match-specific Story of the Match feature and related existing endpoints. All tested critical flows passed.
action_items: Optional hardening: avoid mutable default list in MatchStoryResponse.sources (use Field(default_factory=list)).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: MatchStoryResponse uses mutable default `sources = []`; switch to default_factory to prevent shared-state risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated /api/stories, /api/matches/{match_id}, /api/matches/{match_id}/story (en/ru/pt), cache stability for repeated story calls, and UI modal story rendering from both story card and match card. Tested case with fallback story and no image/sources/video; UI remained stable.
rca of the issue: No functional regression identified in tested scope. External providers can legitimately yield no relevant match article; fallback behavior worked as expected.
